author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

Title says it, inspired by https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/52283#issue-6014476412.
- `hltMuonGEMDigis` now sets `readMultiBX = True`, as the offline Phase-2 GEM unpacker does `(phase2_GEM.toModify(muonGEMDigis, readMultiBX = True))`. With `False`, VFAT frames from other bunch crossings are marked bad and dropped: 86% of the GEM digis at PU200. Here it is set in the cfi rather than with a phase2_GEM modifier, since the menu is Phase-2 only. (originally from https://github.com/artlbv/cmssw/pull/18)

#### PR validation:

`runTheMatrix.py -l ph2_hlt` runs. To be further tested by the bot.
